carrier_launch._doc: M10-T17 (D12.10, Q53, Q71, Q73): a capital carrier's hangar (CapitalHangar, HangarRules). Its craft are its loadout's launches (data/capitals/loadouts.json) in its bays (hardpoints.json). wings: the fighters it launches at a time, first wing first; the first goes when a hostile comes within capital_brain.launch_m, the next when the threat grows to next_wing_threat times what the last wing met (a warship counting warship_weight fighters) or the wings out have lost next_wing_losses of their fighters. Recovery (as the raider carrier's, Q25 to Q30): every craft is called home once no hostile has been within reach for calm_s, a fighter alone under fighter_return_hull of its hull, and all of them before a jump, the jump waiting up to wait_s before it leaves the rest. launch_gap_s: between two craft leaving one bay; lanes: craft side by side at the back of a hall with no lift; elevator_abreast and elevator_rows: craft side by side and rows of them a lift carries a trip, elevator_row_gap_m apart; approach_m: how far outside a mouth a returning craft is taken in; clear_m: how far past the mouth a launch lets go; door_lead_m: a door opens for a returning craft this far out. callsigns: per faction, the wings' callsigns in turn (Livery reads 'Delta 3').

section_damage._doc: M10-T08 (D12.5, Q53), M10-T65 (Q72): how a capital or a station takes damage. Only the part a shot hits takes it: a subsystem (a weapon mount, an engine or a bay within reach of the hit, the bridge or reactor section) takes the full damage and the hull's total subsystem_hull_share of it (no section takes any); any other hit lowers the section it lands in and the hull's total; a lost section's hits go to the total. A magazine, fuel or reactor section at 0 blows the ship up, a hulk or not; the bridge at 0, a reactor at or below reactor_shutdown_at of its points (Q78) or the hull below hulk_below of its points makes a hulk (no power). power_stage_at and power_stage_level: below this share of its points a reactor gives this share of power; mount_reach_m: a hit this close to a live mount (or within its barrel's length), an engine's nozzle (plus its radius) or a bay's mouth (plus half its diagonal) lands on it; engine_hit_points and bay_hit_points: an engine's and a bay's own points (placeholders).

station_damage._doc: M10-T65 (Q72): a station takes damage by the capitals' rules (section_damage) on its own sections (StationSections, 5 000 points each) and grid mounts; its hull's total is its sections' points together. section_kinds: the sections that are its bridge and reactor (the rest are hull); blast: the class row and section kind of its death blast (blasts.sections, unscaled). Babylon 5 is always destructible: losing it fails the mission.

hulks._doc: M10-T10 (D12.7, Q19): a disabled capital loses power at once (its weapons, bays and lights), control at control_loss_s (the helm stops steering, the mains hold their last setting), and its drive winds down to cold at cold_s, after which it drifts with no force; its lights die over lights_fade_s. There is no cap on hulks. never_hulk: factions and hulls that explode when disabled instead of becoming a hulk (the Vorlons and Shadows).

mount_hit_points._doc: M10-T08 (Q53, docs/assets-capital.md 'Sections, mounts and blasts'): a mount's own hit points: by its weapon (by_weapon: the Nova's swivel pulse pods share the fixed pods' housing, M10-T14 follow-up), else by its weapon's kind (data/capitals/loadouts.json), else by the hardpoint's kind.

blasts._doc: M10-T09 (D12.6, Q18, Q53; docs/assets-capital.md 'Sections, mounts and blasts'): every explosion is a falloff blast, damage d0 x f(d) and push dv = impulse x f(d) x A / m (A the mean face area of the hull's box, capped at push_cap_mps), f(d) = (1 - (d/R)^2)^2 with d measured to the hull's nearest hit volume. sources: d0 (hull points at the centre), radius_m, impulse (N s/m^2) by source. sections: per blast class, [d0, radius_m] by explosive section kind and one impulse; a capital's death is the blast of the section that blew (its reactor's without one). classes: a capital class with no row of its own -> the row it takes; factions: a side whose capitals take a row of their own (the ancients: T04's placeholder). scaling: a capital's death is its class row times (hull points / reference_hull of its class)^size_exp x damage_scale^power_exp (hull and damage_scale from loadouts.json), so the rows are the reference hulls' own blasts; radius and impulse take that factor^radius_exp; stand_ins: the loadouts hull a stand-in capital (no type id) scales by; a faction row (the ancients) is not scaled. A pooled hull's death: hulls (asset id -> source) first, else small_craft_death for a hull the loadouts class as small craft, else by_role from the catalogue's role; cargo (asset id -> kind) scales it by cargo_scale (placeholders until the maintainer sets them). flash_j_per_d0: a blast's energy for the far flashes.

capital_brain._doc: M10-T16 (D12.10): the capital brain's numbers. think_hz thinks a second, staggered; engage_share of the main weapon's range is held; approach_mps and arrive_s pace closing and opening; sensor_m is how far it looks; an escort screens screen_min_m to screen_max_m off its charge; it withdraws under withdraw_hull of its hull or withdraw_reactor of its reactor (or with every main engine lost); outgunned_ratio of the target's dps over its own sends its heavy weapons at the mounts bearing on it; keep_bonus and attitude_margin hold a target and an attitude against near ties. launch_m (M10-T17): a carrier counts the hostiles within this for its hangar and holds its course while launching. class_value: a class's worth as a target. doctrine: per faction, threat_w and value_w are the exponents of threat and value in threat x value / time_to_kill, cripple aims at a withdrawing target's engines (default for any faction not listed). fighter_runs: the fighters' attack runs on a capital (fire_from_m to fire_to_m at a subsystem, open to open_m, re-plan every replan_s, regroup at regroup_m after the squadron loses abort_share).
